speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I did not just ask for the pipeline to run without a human touching it. I need the system to catch a missing batch before the forecast job even starts.
output.correction: You are treating this as a simple automation task, but I am talking about adding a hard dependency check. If the store export is late, the forecast must fail loudly rather than running on stale data.
